question: Without what is the ascent of will, knowledge and action never named?
premises: the ascent of will, knowledge and action is never stated apart from it
that ascent rises from the threefold power
it ascends in the Bhairavi consciousness-self
inference: will, knowledge and action ascend only by the threefold power in the consciousness-self
uncertainties: saducyate read as sat plus ucyate, 'is truly said'
plain_english: Will, knowledge and action are never truly named apart from their ascent, and that ascent is the threefold power rising in the consciousness-self of Bhairavī.
